note: Read 2026-11-03 in the Asian Development Bank's copy of PacLII's text of the Labour Act (Cap. 73), Laws of Solomon Islands 1996 Edition (PacLII itself refused this client), held as a secondary source naming PacLII's page. Majority: null; no Act setting it was found. Work: 12. Section 46: no child under twelve may be employed in any capacity, save one employed by and with a parent or guardian on light agricultural, domestic or other work the Commissioner approves; section 47: no one under fifteen in an industrial undertaking (save as the Minister approves) or on a ship; sections 48 and 49: no one under sixteen underground, and no one under eighteen at night in industry or as a trimmer or stoker, none of them held by the form. Performers: barred. The only exception is family light work beside a parent, not performing (a reading). A 2024 reprint under the Legislation Act 2023 is reported, with the same s. 46 heading, and wasn't read. Service: not read (the game doesn't read service).

sources.title: Labour Act (Cap. 73), Laws of Solomon Islands 1996 Edition, ss. 46-49 (Asian Development Bank's copy of PacLII's text)
sources.said: 46. No child under the age of twelve years shall be employed in any capacity whatsoever: Provided that the provisions of this section shall not apply to any such child employed by and in company with his parents (or one of them) or his guardian on light work of an agricultural, domestic or other character which has been approved by the Commissioner.
